Home / Solicitations / SOL-2026-052

Winter de-icing compound, bulk delivery

SOL-2026-052 · Invitation to bid · Streets and Sanitation

Summary

Closing dateSep 25, 2026, 2 p.m. Central
Issuing departmentStreets and Sanitation
ContactTemi Olawale, buyer, bids@lakefront-vn.example
ResponsesRegistered partners only, through the partner console

Scope of work

Delivery of up to 4,800 tons of treated rock salt to the Canal Row and Ridge Street salt domes between November 1 and March 31, in loads called off with 48 hours' notice.

  • Price per ton, delivered.
  • Minimum guaranteed purchase of 2,400 tons.
  • Liquidated damages for loads delivered more than 24 hours late.

Addenda

No addenda have been issued.

Questions about this solicitation go to the contact above in writing, no later than seven days before the closing date. Answers are published here as addenda.
